The Trump Mobile T1 finally shipped, and as one of the first paying customers in the world, I tore the $499 "Made in USA" Trump phone apart to find out what it really is. Spoiler: it's not the rebadged T-Mobile REVL Pro 5G everyone claimed — it's a gold HTC U24 Pro with a bigger battery, a broken in-display fingerprint sensor, and a Snapdragon 7 Gen 3. From pre-order emails landing in Gmail spam thanks to botched DMARC records, to paying for the $47.45 Trump Mobile 47 Plan over the phone, the entire buying experience was a disaster worthy of its own review.
